name: @pipeworx/mcp-dogsapi

tools.name: list_breeds
tools.description: Search dog breeds with pagination. Returns breed names, IDs, weight ranges, life spans, and hypoallergenic status. Use get_breed for detailed info on a specific breed.

tools.name: get_breed
tools.description: Get detailed info about a dog breed by ID. Returns characteristics, temperament, origin, size, and health data.

tools.name: list_facts
tools.description: Get random dog facts. Returns interesting trivia about dog behavior, history, and abilities.

limit.description: Number of facts to return (default: 10, max: 100)

tools.name: get_groups
tools.description: Get all AKC dog breed groups (e.g., Sporting, Herding, Terrier). Returns group names and descriptions.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dogsapi forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dogsapi pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
